clue.text: Tofu cooked by partners for the rest of the Japanese

definitions.text: for the rest of the Japanese
definitions.note: a descriptive phrase for the plural noun

indicators.note: cooking food transforms it, so the bean-curd word is prepared in a new order

blocks.note: taken as written, the bean curd
North and South are partners at the bridge table

explanation.surface: A Japanese cook and companions prepare bean curd for the rest of the household.
explanation.walkthrough: 'For the rest' suggests the remainder of a meal, but rest here is sleep: FUTONS are the traditional Japanese bedding.
explanation.definitionFit: Futons are the thin padded mattresses traditionally unrolled on the floor for sleeping in Japan.

clue.text: Society a number in university set up

indicators.note: in a down clue, setting something up raises it so it reads from bottom to top

blocks.note: No. is the abbreviation for number
taken as written
U is the abbreviation for university

explanation.surface: A student society is founded with a certain membership at a university.
explanation.walkthrough: NO IN U written upwards gives UNION, the name of many university debating societies.
explanation.definitionFit: A union is an association or club, as in a students' union or the Oxford Union debating society.

clue.text: Edge to the slips, perhaps, is a slight possibility

blocks.note: first meaning, in cricket: a catch offered on the off side, where the slip fielders stand
second meaning: a remote likelihood

explanation.surface: A cricket commentator notes an edge flying towards the slip fielders.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an edge is a ball glancing off the bat; slips are catchers beside the wicketkeeper on the off side, so an edge to them is a catching chance on the off side.
explanation.definitionFit: On the off chance means in the faint hope that something unlikely might happen.

clue.text: Progress made in piano-playing style

blocks.note: first meaning: an advance
second meaning: a jazz piano style with a striding left hand

explanation.surface: A pupil is improving at a particular method of playing the piano.
explanation.walkthrough: Stride piano is an early jazz style in which the left hand leaps between bass notes and chords.
explanation.definitionFit: A stride is a step forward, so progress; it is also the name of the Harlem jazz piano style.

clue.text: Dog gets pieces I put in this dish

indicators.note: the single letter is placed inside the word for chessmen

blocks.note: the chow is a Chinese breed of dog
chess or draughts pieces are men
taken as written

explanation.surface: A dog snatches scraps from a plate the speaker has prepared.
explanation.walkthrough: The chow is a Chinese breed, which suits the Chinese dish; pieces are chessmen, not morsels.
explanation.definitionFit: Chow mein is a Chinese-style plate of stir-fried noodles, so it is a dish.

clue.text: Alternative suggestion from bartender?

blocks.note: surface reading: a rival offer put forward in a negotiation
setter's reading: a bartender works behind the bar, so a drink offered across it comes from that side

explanation.surface: A barman suggests something other than what the customer asked for.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer: a bartender stands at the counter, so a bartender's proposal is a counter one.
explanation.definitionFit: A counter-proposal is an alternative offer made in reply to one already put forward in negotiations.

clue.text: Produce too many deliveries to carry

blocks.note: in cricket an over is a set of six deliveries bowled
to bear is to carry

explanation.surface: A firm has too many orders to transport.
explanation.walkthrough: Deliveries looks like parcels, but in cricket a delivery is a ball bowled and six make an over.
explanation.definitionFit: Overbear, of a plant or tree, means to yield fruit to excess so it is weakened.

clue.text: Brawny friend embracing sweetheart

indicators.note: to embrace is to hug, so the friend's word holds the other letter inside

blocks.note: maty is a variant spelling of matey, a familiar word for a friend
the heart, or middle letter, of the word sweet

explanation.surface: A muscular companion hugs a loved one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sweetheart' looks like a lover but is a standard crossword trick for the centre letter of sweet.
explanation.definitionFit: Meaty describes a heavily built, muscular person, the same as brawny or solid.

clue.text: Mess I clean out to protect against disease

indicators.note: making a mess of something jumbles it, so the letters that follow are scrambled

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone resolves to clear up a mess to keep germs away.
explanation.definitionFit: To inoculate is to give a vaccine, making someone immune to an infection.

clue.text: Mark is supporting agreement? Hard luck!

blocks.note: M is an abbreviation for mark, the old German currency
taken as written
to be for something is to support it
being in tune is being in agreement

explanation.surface: Someone backing a deal is told, sympathetically, that it has gone wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: Mark looks like a person's name; it is just M.
explanation.definitionFit: Misfortune means bad luck or an unlucky event, matching the consoling phrase hard luck.

clue.text: Call at sea from a fishing boat

blocks.note: taken as written
a hoy is a small coastal sailing vessel

explanation.surface: A shout comes from a fishing vessel out on the water.
explanation.definitionFit: Ahoy is the sailor's traditional greeting used to hail another ship or a person aboard.

clue.text: Relating to dowry, exactly as arranged

blocks.note: on means about or concerning
dot is the French word for a dowry, adopted in English, with the article added

explanation.surface: A marriage settlement is drawn up precisely as agreed.
explanation.walkthrough: A dot (from French) is a bride's dowry; ON (relating to) THE DOT gives the phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: On the dot means punctually, at precisely the time that was agreed in advance.

clue.text: Composer shown round the old university in historic French town

indicators.note: the composer's name is wrapped around the other pieces as a guide leads visitors round

blocks.note: Sir Arnold Bax, English composer
ye is an archaic spelling of the
U is the abbreviation for university

explanation.surface: A composer is given a tour of an ancient university in a French town.
explanation.walkthrough: Arnold Bax (1883-1953) was Master of the King's Music; his short surname is a crossword favourite.
explanation.definitionFit: Bayeux in Normandy is famous for its tapestry and cathedral, an old French town of great history.

clue.text: Part of stove, normally

indicators.note: only a portion of the following run of letters is wanted

blocks.note: hidden across the two words

explanation.surface: A remark that a cooking appliance usually has some component.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Part of' does double duty, pointing to the hidden letters and forming the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen range commonly combines hob rings on top with an enclosed baking compartment below.

clue.text: Vehicle with insurance carrying you, say, in city

indicators.note: say marks a word that is to be taken by its sound rather than its spelling
carrying means holding, so the insurance word holds the sound piece within it

blocks.note: a van is a vehicle
insurance cover
the letter U is pronounced like this pronoun

explanation.surface: A van with insurance gives someone a lift somewhere in town.
explanation.walkthrough: Cover is the usual British word for the protection an insurance policy gives.
explanation.definitionFit: Vancouver is the large Pacific port in British Columbia, Canada.

clue.text: Come back later to harvest some fruit

blocks.note: to reap is to harvest a crop
a pear is one fruit

explanation.surface: Someone is told to return afterwards to gather a crop of fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: To reappear is to show up again after being away, so to return into view.

clue.text: Not part of the driving force?

definitions.text: Not part of the driving force?

blocks.clueFragment: Not part of the driving force
blocks.note: surface reading: someone who is no key element in pushing a project forward
setter's reading: someone in a vehicle who is not the driver, just being carried along

explanation.surface: A team member who contributes nothing to the effort.
explanation.walkthrough: The word also means a team member who does no work, so both readings fit.
explanation.definitionFit: A passenger rides in a car without driving, and figuratively is a member carried by colleagues' work.

clue.text: Person who separates out refuse present in drink, right?

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the word for a drink

blocks.note: wine is a drink
now is the present time
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: Someone sorting rubbish finds a gift in their drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Present' looks like a gift but is the present time; 'refuse' belongs to the definition, meaning chaff.
explanation.definitionFit: A winnower blows away chaff from grain, separating out the worthless husks.

clue.text: Poor gather outside South American city

indicators.note: the verb for gather sits around the city name, its letters split either side

blocks.note: to gather a conclusion is to infer it
Rio de Janeiro in Brazil

explanation.surface: Impoverished people gather on the edge of a South American city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Poor' looks like a description of the people gathering, but it is the definition in the sense of low quality.
explanation.definitionFit: Poor in the sense of low quality; something inferior is of a lower standard than others.

clue.text: Abandoned female with daughter

blocks.note: she is the female pronoun
D is the abbreviation for daughter

explanation.surface: A woman and her daughter have been deserted.
explanation.definitionFit: To shed something is to cast it off or get rid of it, so shed means discarded or given up.

clue.text: Doctor struggles to provide alternative to theatre

blocks.note: MO is a medical officer, an army doctor
to vie is to compete or struggle

explanation.surface: A doctor battles to offer something other than a night at a play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' and 'struggles' look like an anagram pairing, but MO plus VIES is straight charade.
explanation.definitionFit: Going to the cinema to see films is an evening out instead of seeing a live stage play.

clue.text: Travel with right fellow, a military hero

blocks.note: to go is to travel
R is the abbreviation for right
a don is a fellow of a university college

explanation.surface: A war hero journeys alongside a suitable companion.
explanation.walkthrough: General Charles Gordon, 'Gordon of Khartoum', died defending that city in 1885.
explanation.definitionFit: General Gordon was a celebrated Victorian British army officer, famous for his last stand at Khartoum.

clue.text: Capital invested by the British in Asia

definitions.text: invested by the British in Asia
definitions.note: a descriptive phrase for the city

blocks.note: first meaning: the capital city of India

blocks.clueFragment: invested by the British in Asia
blocks.note: second meaning: the Asian city besieged by British forces in 1857

explanation.surface: British money is put into business ventures in Asia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital invested' reads as money, but to invest a city also means to besiege it, as British troops did here during the Indian Rebellion of 1857.
explanation.definitionFit: Delhi is the Indian seat of government, and in 1857 it was surrounded and recaptured by British troops.

clue.text: Characteristic article on stage

blocks.note: first meaning: a quality or attribute
second meaning: a theatrical prop, an object used in a play

explanation.walkthrough: A stage prop is short for this word, an item used by actors in a scene.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both an inherent attribute of something and any movable object used by actors in a play.

clue.text: May, for example, attach name to god

blocks.note: Thor is the Norse god of thunder
N is the abbreviation for name

explanation.surface: A person called May adds a deity's name to her own.
explanation.walkthrough: May is hawthorn blossom, and hawthorn is a kind of thorn.
explanation.definitionFit: May is another name for the hawthorn, a spiny shrub or tree, so an example of a thorn.

clue.text: Be back in base

indicators.note: going back means the word for existing is read from its end

blocks.note: to live is to be, to exist

explanation.surface: An instruction to return to headquarters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Base' sounds like a camp, but here it is the adjective meaning low or wicked.
explanation.definitionFit: Base as an adjective means morally low and wicked, the same as evil.

clue.text: City-state

blocks.note: first meaning: the US capital
second meaning: the US state in the Pacific Northwest

explanation.walkthrough: 'City-state' looks like one term for something like Singapore, but the hyphen hides two separate meanings of one name.
explanation.definitionFit: Washington names both the American federal capital and a separate north-western American state.

clue.text: Like legal judgment disturbing bar — new trial needed

indicators.note: disturbing something throws it into disorder, so these letters are shaken up
a new version of a word is a fresh arrangement of its letters

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A court ruling that upsets the legal profession means a retrial is required.
explanation.walkthrough: Bar (the legal profession) and trial both sit naturally in the court scene, hiding that they are only letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Arbitral describes an arbiter or arbitration, the settling of a dispute by an impartial judgment.

clue.text: Race to produce second edition

blocks.note: S is the abbreviation for second
a print run, or printing, is an edition of a book

explanation.surface: A publisher hurries to bring out a further edition.
explanation.definitionFit: A sprint is a short race run at full speed over a brief distance.
